title: Remote viewing Jesus as a personality-profile target

plain: Lyn Buchanan, a former Army sergeant in a military remote viewing unit in the 1980s, says he was once asked to profile the personality of a hidden target that turned out to be Jesus. Remote viewing is the claimed ability to describe something hidden with the mind alone. Buchanan says he did the session himself and judged the person a 'good guy,' and then the monitor opened the envelope and 'our director had written the word Jesus on it.'
